description: Renewal-service tests that inject a fixed clock everywhere except one: the annual-plan test builds RenewalService() on the real clock and asserts a plan ending 2026-12-31 is active, so it starts failing once that date passes (Erratic Test, nondeterministic timing)

hard.note: One of eight otherwise clean tests omits the injected clock; the only signal is a missing constructor argument next to a future literal date

_calibration.note: Modeled on test-assertion-roulette (fail on a behavior smell): one error for the real-clock time bomb, room for up to two minor duplication suggestions
